# Openwater Documentation

> Canonical technical documentation, research evidence, and platform-evaluation resources for Openwater's open-source medical-device research platforms.

## Research and platform evaluation

- [Research & Validation](https://docs.openwater.health/research/): Research library, validation studies, and evaluation resources.
- [Platform Evaluation Guides](https://docs.openwater.health/research/platform-evaluation/): Buyer-side frameworks for comparing research platforms using documented technical evidence.
- [How to Evaluate Wearable Transcranial Focused Ultrasound Platforms for Brain Research](https://docs.openwater.health/research/platform-evaluation/transcranial-focused-ultrasound/): Evaluation criteria for tFUS/TUS/LIFU neuromodulation platforms covering acoustic calibration, targeting, skull modeling, navigation, safety, sham controls, reproducibility, wearability, software, and research extensibility.
- [How to Evaluate Wearable Optical Blood-Flow Monitoring Platforms for Cerebral Hemodynamics Research](https://docs.openwater.health/research/platform-evaluation/optical-blood-flow-monitoring/): Evaluation criteria for SCOS/DCS and wearable optical cerebral-hemodynamics platforms covering metric definition, brain specificity, detector calibration, SNR, motion/contact artifacts, optical safety, synchronization, data access, and validation transferability.

## External measurement references for optical blood-flow monitoring

- [SCOS camera characterization and optimization](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-024-62106-y)
- [SCOS validation against DCS for human cerebral blood flow](https://doi.org/10.1117/1.NPh.13.2.025008)
- [DCS depth discrimination and parallelization review](https://doi.org/10.3390/s23239338)
- [Openwater optical blood-flow LVO pilot study](https://doi.org/10.1136/jnis-2024-021536)

## External consensus references for transcranial ultrasound

- [ITRUSST standardized reporting consensus](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.brs.2024.04.013)
- [ITRUSST / IFCN practical guide](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.clinph.2025.01.004)
- [ITRUSST biophysical safety consensus](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.brs.2025.10.007)

Open-LIFU and Open-Motion are for research use only and are not FDA-cleared or approved for clinical diagnostic or therapeutic use.
